*** Please Note This Property Has Tested Positive For Pyrite. This property is not eligible for a mortgage ***
John Giltinane Auctioneer & Associates are delighted to bring to the market this attractive three-bedroom, two-bathroom semi-detached home is ready to welcome its new owners. Ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac just off the South Circular Road, this highly sought-after location is within easy walking distance of the city center.

The property offers a well-designed and spacious layout. A bright entrance hallway leads to the inviting sitting room, featuring a large bay window, original parquet flooring, a central fireplace, and French doors opening into the formal dining room. The dining area flows seamlessly into the well-appointed open-plan kitchen and breakfast area, which extends into a light-filled sunroom. French doors from the sunroom open onto a private rear garden complete with a patio area and garden shed, providing the perfect space for outdoor entertaining and relaxation. A guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the first floor comprises three generously proportioned bedrooms, all with fitted wardrobes, together with a spacious family bathroom featuring a bath, separate shower, vanity unit, and WC.

Externally, the property benefits from off-street parking for one car to the front and a convenient side entrance providing access to the private rear garden.

This is a wonderful opportunity to acquire a superb family home in an exceptional location. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this property has to offer
Hallway, Living Room, Dining Room, Open Plan Eat In Kitchen, Sunroom, W.c, Master bedroom, 2 Double Bedroom, a Hall bathroom & Linen Closet.
